title: Feed The Supper Man, Or He KNOCKS 🍽️
description:
Every Friday, every porch on our street leaves a plate out for the Supper Man. Forget, and he knocks all night until you open the door.

Forty-three porches, forty-two plates. The only porch that never leaves one is my grandpa's, and nobody has ever heard a knock there. Last Friday I didn't put ours out.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment PLATE if your street would do it too.
